about.title: The voice every Pole grew up with
about.body1: Poland never dubbed foreign films with a cast of actors. We got one man instead. The lektor read every line, flat and unbothered, over the quieted original. Stallone, Streep, aliens, children: one voice. The style is called szeptanka, 'whispering'. Foreigners hear a broken television. Poles hear home.
about.body2: Mati Staniszewski and Piotr Dąbkowski grew up on that voice and started ElevenLabs partly because of it. They wanted machines that speak every language properly. In 2026 their company was valued at $22 billion, weeks after the Polish government put money into it.
about.body3: This site closes the loop: the technology the lektor inspired now reads like him. Every clip is transcribed with scribe_v2, translated into flat lektor Polish by an LLM, read by a single designed voice with multilingual v2, and mixed over the quieted original with the authentic 600 to 900 ms delay. He always starts late. That's the craft.
about.body4: No real lektor was cloned for this. Not Knapik, not Gudowski, nobody. The voice was designed from scratch: an archetype, not a person. I'm Polish, so I checked twice.

powiedz.title: Say it like a lektor
powiedz.hint: Type anything in any language and the lektor reads it back exactly as written, with his professional indifference. Nothing gets translated here. If you put English in, you get English out, plus a Polish shrug. Works for tweets, threats and wedding vows.
powiedz.placeholder: e.g. I'm going to make him an offer he can't refuse
powiedz.error: The lektor refuses. Try again in a moment.
powiedz.tooLong: Keep it under {max} characters. The lektor is a busy man.
